Container.Name: VynodeIPTV
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: iptv xtream epg television android shield video wall
Container.Requires: x86-64 CPU; configuration and scratch directories writable by UID/GID 10001; authorized IPTV provider account for live channels. Read the installation guide before first launch.
Container.Changes: 0.17.0: For You recommendations with team emblems, city/state and local-station preferences, favorite genres, and current/upcoming EPG listings. Available on browser and standalone or linked Android.
Container.Overview: Preview release for x86-64 Unraid. Native Shield companion with Xtream providers, guide grids, custom channel groups, independent browser video walls, output health diagnostics and server-side HLS remux or CPU conversion. GPU transcoding not implemented. Create a username and password in the WebUI. Existing installations use their previous key once to authorize account setup. Appdata and transcode directories must be writable by UID/GID 10001.
